href.description: Link target — an internal route or an external URL.

NavNode.description: A sidebar entry: a page (linking to its route) or a group holding further nodes.

path.description: The group's route prefix (not necessarily a page).

route.description: The group's index page route, when it has one.

NavSelector.description: A top-level partition selector (products, versions, languages).

root.description: The tree root's route (`/`, or a locale/version prefix).

markdown.description: The page as agent Markdown: frontmatter included, components downleveled to plain Markdown.

links.description: Recovery links, when there is somewhere useful to go.

excerpt.description: The page description, else the start of its content.

info.description:
Read-only JSON API over the supercarto documentation: Documentation for supercarto — token-budgeted map context for AI agents: one call returns a walkable topological graph of any coordinate, with weather, terrain, daylight, indoor floors and GTFS transit built in.

Every operation is public and needs no authentication. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code`, a `detail`, and a `resolution` hint.
info.title: supercarto API

get.description: Every documentation page with its route, title, description, content type, locale, facets, and the URLs of its rendered, Markdown, and JSON forms. Unfiltered; on a versioned site every version is listed with its `version`. Use it to enumerate the docs or to find a page when search is too narrow.
A single page as JSON: its index entry plus the page's agent Markdown (frontmatter included, components downleveled to plain Markdown). Take `route` from `listPages` or `searchDocs`.

parameters.description: The page route without its leading slash (`guides/install`), or `index` for the home page. May contain slashes.
parameters.name: route

get.description: The navigation tree (header tabs and the sidebar hierarchy) as readers see it, for the default locale and the current docs.

A page's raw-Markdown mirror: append `.md` to any page URL. Components are downleveled to plain Markdown; `.mdx` serves the source as written. The same body the `getPage` operation carries in its `markdown` field.

parameters.description: The page route without its leading slash (`guides/install`), or `index` for the home page. May contain slashes.
parameters.name: route

404.description: No page has that route; the body lists where to look next.

get.description: The llms.txt index: the site's summary, when to use it, and every page with a one-line description, grouped by section.
The full Markdown of every current-docs page in one file.
A manifest indexing every agent-facing artifact the site publishes — this API, the Markdown mirrors, llms.txt, the MCP server, feeds, and the sitemap.
